versions.changelog:
discord-community-hub-free v1.0.0

- Initial release of the free edition Discord community management tool.
- Supports viewing user profile, server list, member and role information, server widget and invite details (all read-only).
- Enables basic integration setup, account linking, and tool discovery via integration gateway.
- All write operations (e.g. user info modifications, server leave, command permissions) are disabled in this free version.
- Designed for personal use and lightweight community overview scenarios.
